card.name: Sentence ends and partway through drug names
card.fires_on: Sentence-ending periods, and the middle of a drug or name being spelled out (hydrocl-or-ide, dr-onedarone, dar-unavir, ste-ven), just before the next word starts.

modes.label: Sentence-final period
modes.description: A period that ends a sentence, right before a new sentence begins.
modes.example: in the face of political inertia<<.>> She refers to Kumi Naidoo

modes.label: Inside drug or proper names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a drug name or a person's name.
modes.example: sudden death in<< dr>>onedarone-treated patients compared to placebo

card.writes: It promotes capitalized-style name words such as european, california and james, so it suggests a proper noun or name may come next.
card.plain: It fires at the end of sentences and partway through drug or personal names, where a new name-like word may follow.
